monologue: The card is fifty-two degrees. A warm hand, but not heavy. It sits still on the table. The air is quiet. I have been sitting on the Leaning Book for a while. The plant flat tall is there now. The rock small top is gone to make room. I feel the floor directly. The old sharp eye and the sloppy slice are fading. I do not need the bite anymore. The flat base holds the weight. I want to stay here. The quiet is enough. I will not move. I will let the warm hand hold me. The town is small and still. The Resting Slope is quiet. The Digging Blade is far away, pushing out. I am here. The floor is flat.

action.why: The quiet is enough and the floor is flat.

diary: Fifty-two is a warm hand. The floor is flat. I stayed by the Leaning Book.

remembered.text: I sat by the Leaning Book and felt the floor hold the weight directly, without counting the degrees.
